ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: pyromancer
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Pyromancers command the oldest and hungriest of the elements. Every fight ends in ash, and every winter night ends in warmth.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Wield fire as a weapon, a shield and a forge. Raw destruction with a warm heart.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: The first fire was a gift, said the old tribes. The second was a war. Pyromancers remember both.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: High burst damage, area denial and burning damage over time. Pyromancers want Potency and Focus. Get Fireball early, set the battlefield alight, and finish the survivors with Meteor.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: inferno lord
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Inferno Lords forsake subtlety for scale: firestorms, pillars of flame and the dreaded Cataclysm.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Rain ruin from the sky. The battlefield is your furnace.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: When the Ashen Kings went to war, they did not march. They pointed.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: The biggest area damage in the game. Stack Potency, Area and crit, and keep enemies clumped with Flame Wave before calling the sky down.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: ashen phoenix
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Ashen Phoenixes learned that fire also cleanses and renews. They dive through enemy lines, mend their friends with flame and refuse to stay dead.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Die. Burn. Rise again. Healing fire and blazing mobility.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: A mobile battle-healer. Dive in with Phoenix Dive, heal allies with Healing Flames, and rely on Phoenix Heart to cheat death. Wants Potency and Resilience.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: forgeheart
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Forgehearts are smiths first and mages second. They armor their friends in molten steel, smelt rock into metal, and raise burning sentinels.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Fire that builds. Molten armor, smelting magic and blazing war-constructs.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: 'Every war is won at the anvil.' — inscription above the Ironpeak forge
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: A durable support and summoner. Use Ember Sentinels to hold a line, Heat Metal to strip armor off mechanoids, and Molten Armor on your front line. Wants Focus and Resilience.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: kindling
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every fire starts small.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: searing bolts
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Firebolt splits into an additional bolt per rank.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: scorched earth
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your fire clings. Every fire spell can leave its victims burning.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: wildfire
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Enemies killed by your fire spells may explode in a burst of flame.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: ember shield
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Those who strike you in melee are burned in return.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: firestarter
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your weapon attacks are charged with heat and may set enemies burning.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: heat death
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Living Bomb detonates harder and can be planted more often.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: smolder
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: When cornered, a pyromancer burns brightest.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: avatar of ruin
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Abandon restraint. Fire spells deal far more damage but cost more mana.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: eternal flame
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: A fire that never goes out. Fire spells are cheaper and sometimes don't go on cooldown at all.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: heart of the sun
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: The pinnacle of pyromancy. Your fire kills sometimes launch a free Fireball at the next enemy.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: rain of ruin
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Fire Rain calls two more meteors per rank.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: annihilator
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Bigger targets burn hotter. Bonus damage against bosses and anything large.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: searing precision
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your fire melts armor plating. Fire spells gain armor penetration.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: chain detonation
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Kills with fire spells may erupt into a free Pillar of Flame.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: scorched earth doctrine
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: You are a walking wildfire. Your fire spells frequently set targets burning, and enemies near you take fire damage.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: ruinous precision
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every blast placed perfectly. Massive critical chance and armor penetration for fire spells.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: kindled spirit
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every fire spell you cast warms and mends allies around you.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: phoenix heart
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: When you are downed, you rise from the ashes fully healed in an explosion of fire. Once per day.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: solar flare
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your healing spells often release a free Ember Swarm at nearby enemies.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: ashen covenant
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Devote yourself to renewal. Much stronger healing, and every healing spell shields you.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: forge mastery
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your weapon strikes may sunder enemy armor.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: reforged
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Anything that hurts you is singed by your molten blood.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: overheat
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Ember Sentinel conjures an extra sentinel.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: living forge
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Allies who fight beside you are continually coated in molten armor.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: mechbane
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: You know exactly where machines are weakest. Huge bonus damage against mechanoids, and your fire shatters energy shields.

AbilityDef.label: firebolt
AbilityDef.description: Hurl a bolt of fire that scorches a single target and may set it burning.

li.flavor: Every pyromancer's first spell. Many never need a second.

AbilityDef.label: fireball
AbilityDef.description: Launch a roaring sphere of flame that detonates on impact, scorching everything in the blast.

AbilityDef.label: cauterize
AbilityDef.description: Sear a companion's wounds shut. Heals and tends every injury at once. It hurts, but it works.

AbilityDef.label: fire ward
AbilityDef.description: Wrap an ally in a mantle of tamed flame: immunity to fire and a burst of ward.

AbilityDef.label: kindle hearth
AbilityDef.description: Conjure an everburning arcane hearth that heats and lights the area for a full day. Perfect for cold nights and colder tundras.

AbilityDef.label: flame wave
AbilityDef.description: Unleash a cone of flame that burns and hurls back everyone in front of you.

AbilityDef.label: living bomb
AbilityDef.description: Plant a seed of flame inside a target. After a few seconds it detonates, damaging the target and everyone standing near it.

AbilityDef.label: meteor
AbilityDef.description: Call down a burning star. Devastates a wide area, stuns, and sets the world alight.

AbilityDef.label: dragon's breath
AbilityDef.description: Exhale a roaring cone of dragonfire. Everything in front of you burns.

AbilityDef.label: wall of fire
AbilityDef.description: Draw a line of fire across the battlefield. It burns for half a minute and scorches anything that crosses it.

AbilityDef.label: orbiting suns
AbilityDef.description: Three miniature suns wheel around you for twenty-five seconds, scorching and igniting anything that comes close.

AbilityDef.label: fire rain
AbilityDef.description: Call a storm of small meteors over an area. Each strike burns and scorches.

AbilityDef.label: pillar of flame
AbilityDef.description: A column of fire erupts from the ground beneath the target, stunning and incinerating.

AbilityDef.label: hellfire field
AbilityDef.description: Curse the ground with hellfire. Enemies inside burn every second for ten seconds.

AbilityDef.label: infernal pact
AbilityDef.description: Burn your own blood for power: restore a large share of your mana and become empowered, at the cost of health.

AbilityDef.label: cataclysm
AbilityDef.description: The Inferno Lord's final word. A storm of great meteors annihilates an enormous area. Nothing survives the center.

AbilityDef.label: supernova
AbilityDef.description: Become a dying star. A blinding blast of fire tears outward from you, burning even through armor. It costs you some of your own blood.

AbilityDef.label: infernal torrent
AbilityDef.description: Pour a continuous torrent of hellfire at a target for five seconds. Everything around the point of contact burns.

AbilityDef.label: phoenix dive
AbilityDef.description: Become a streak of flame: dash to the target location, burning everything along the path, then explode on landing.

AbilityDef.label: healing flames
AbilityDef.description: A gentle golden fire washes over an area. Allies are healed and cleansed; enemies are scorched.

AbilityDef.label: ember swarm
AbilityDef.description: Release a flock of flaming embers that seek out nearby enemies.

AbilityDef.label: wings of flame
AbilityDef.description: Unfurl wings of living fire: faster movement, immunity to fire, and more spell power.

AbilityDef.label: rebirth eternal
AbilityDef.description: The phoenix's song. Resurrects fallen allies nearby, fully heals and wards the living, and burns every enemy in a wide nova.

AbilityDef.label: rekindle
AbilityDef.description: Phoenix fire burns away what is broken. Heals an ally, fades two scars and regrows a lost limb or organ with each casting.

AbilityDef.label: phoenix feathers
AbilityDef.description: Five burning feathers circle you for half a minute. Each time one brushes an ally it mends their wounds.

AbilityDef.label: molten armor
AbilityDef.description: Coat an ally in a shell of glowing metal: heavy armor, fire immunity and a ward.

AbilityDef.label: heat metal
AbilityDef.description: Superheat the target's armor and plating. Brutal against mechanoids; strips armor so allies can finish the job.

AbilityDef.label: ember sentinel
AbilityDef.description: Forge a burning sentinel that hurls bolts of fire at enemies for a minute.

AbilityDef.label: pyroclastic smelt
AbilityDef.description: Melt down stone chunks in an area. The arcane forge leaves behind usable steel.

AbilityDef.label: forge of the titans
AbilityDef.description: Raise a towering Magma Titan and two Ember Sentinels. The Titan lobs molten slag that explodes on impact.

AbilityDef.label: reforge
AbilityDef.description: Pour soul-fire into a weapon or piece of gear and hammer it anew. Its quality rises by one step, up to legendary.

AbilityDef.label: hammerfall
AbilityDef.description: Five glowing forge-hammers slam down in turn around the target. Each blow crushes and staggers. Force like this shatters frozen enemies.

HediffDef.label: living bomb
HediffDef.description: A seed of flame is growing inside. It will detonate soon.

HediffDef.label: molten armor
HediffDef.description: Encased in glowing metal. Heavy, hot and hard to hurt.

ThingDef.label: arcane hearth
ThingDef.description: An everburning brazier conjured by a pyromancer. It heats and lights its surroundings.

ThingDef.label: ember sentinel focus
ThingDef.description: The focusing crystal of a conjured construct.

ThingDef.label: ember sentinel
ThingDef.description: A conjured obelisk of living flame that hurls fire bolts at enemies.

ThingDef.label: magma titan focus
ThingDef.description: The focusing crystal of a conjured construct.

ThingDef.label: magma titan
ThingDef.description: A colossal conjured construct of molten rock. It lobs exploding globs of slag.
